purpose: Challenge finite composition of actual interpreter state transitions through exact persistent context refs without promoting that composition into a generic inference/transitivity rule.

stepOracle.scope: run-topology test carrier only; does not replace the preferred role-bundle act from the integrated decision

requiredAssertions: two valid acts with exact shared intermediate context form a valid run
reordered acts with broken context adjacency reject
skipping a necessary intermediate act rejects
an act valid in isolation can still reject at the wrong run position
one interpreter I participates in all acts of one candidate run
D and T remain explicit per act and may change between adjacent acts
persistent K refs are not mutated by run construction or replay
two otherwise identical no-op actual acts may have distinct A refs
the run cell chain preserves both duplicate act occurrences and their order
a finite run may return to an earlier context ref without infinite unfolding
two alternative acts from one K produce distinct branch runs
changing D or T in one act changes that act evidence rather than silently reusing previous environment
forged run terminal cell, act ref, interpreter ref or transition rejects
run composition does not create a direct K0-to-Kn relation or generic P-to-R theorem
notDecided: whether this run cell topology is canonical
how the final Gate-R act header/role vocabulary replaces the temporary step oracle
